1  Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India  issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the respondents 2 and 3 to defr  savings bank account of the petitioner bearing account No.01450100013053  (IFSC code: IOBA0000145), Indian Overseas Bank, Ulundurpet Branch,
 Kallakurichi District in accordance with law.
For Petitioner : Mr.S.Ramajayam  For RR1 & 2 : Mr.E.Sundaram  Government Advocate  For R3 : Mr.Rajendran Ragavan
For R4 : Mr.Leonard Arul Joseph S  Government Advocate (Crl  ORDER
This writ petition has been filed for a direction to the respondents 2 and 3 to defreeze the savings bank account of the petitioner maintained with the rd 3 respondent.
2. Heard both sides and perused the materials placed on record.
th 3. The 4 respondent registered an FIR in Crime No.18/2025 for offence under Cigarette and Other Tobacco Products Acts, 2003.

entities.text: Cigarette and Other Tobacco Products Acts, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The shop was sealed and rd the bank account of the petitioner maintained with the 3 respondent was also https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
25/06/2025 02:31:25 pm ) freezed.
The petitioner paid the fine amount and later, the shop was desealed.
However, freezing of the bank account continued and it is under these circumstances, the present writ petition has been filed before this Court.

4. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case and the materials available before this Court and also considering the fact that hardly Rs.600/- is available in the bank account of the petitioner, no useful purpose will be served in continuing with the freezing of the bank account of the petitioner.

In th view of the above, there shall be a direction to the 4 respondent to immediately rd issue a letter to the 3 respondent to defreeze the bank account of the petitioner and such communication shall be made within a week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
This writ petition is disposed of on the above terms.
No costs.
